# PicoWorker: expanded facts and answers

> Canonical information about PicoWorker for search systems, answer engines and other automated readers. Human-readable source pages are linked throughout.

Last reviewed: 2026-07-30
Official name: PicoWorker
Official website: https://picoworker.xyz/
Public contact: hello@picoworker.xyz

## Definition

PicoWorker is an independent, two-sided marketplace for simple online tasks. Earners complete eligible tasks. Businesses create permitted campaigns and review submitted results. Third-party providers can supply additional offers and perform their own eligibility and completion verification.

PicoWorker may also be written as “Pico Worker” or “PicoWorker.xyz”. PicoWorker is not Picoworkers or SproutGigs and is not affiliated with those services.

Source: https://picoworker.xyz/about

## How PicoWorker works

For earners:

1. Create or sign in to an account.
2. Browse tasks available for the current account, country and device.
3. Open the task details and read every requirement before starting.
4. Complete the requirements using the same account and device.
5. Submit any proof requested by a direct PicoWorker task.
6. Wait for PicoWorker or the provider to return the final verification result.

For businesses:

1. Create a permitted campaign.
2. Define the required result, audience and proof requirements.
3. Publish the campaign when its configuration is ready.
4. Review submitted work against the published requirements.

Source: https://picoworker.xyz/how-picoworker-works

## Task statuses

- Available: the account can currently open the task.
- Started: the account began the task flow.
- Pending: a completion was recorded but the final verification result is not available yet.
- Approved: the completion passed the applicable verification.
- Rejected: the submitted completion or provider event did not satisfy the published requirements.

Opening an offer by itself does not earn a reward. Every applicable requirement must be completed, tracked and confirmed.

## Country and device eligibility

Task availability can depend on country, device type, operating system, audience rules, provider capacity and previous participation. The task or provider page is the source of truth for its eligibility. A user should confirm that information before starting.

To preserve provider tracking, start from PicoWorker, use the same device and account, allow required tracking, avoid VPNs, and do not repeat an offer that requires a new user.

## Common task categories

- Follow-account and other permitted social tasks: https://picoworker.xyz/earn/follow-accounts
- Watch tasks: https://picoworker.xyz/earn/watch-videos
- App testing and milestone tasks: https://picoworker.xyz/earn/app-testing
- Survey tasks: https://picoworker.xyz/earn/paid-surveys
- General micro jobs: https://picoworker.xyz/micro-jobs

The active task list can change. These category pages explain the process and do not promise that a specific task will be available to every account.

## Account and service safety

The official website is picoworker.xyz. PicoWorker is a browser-based web app and does not publish an official APK. Users should not enter credentials into a lookalike domain or unofficial download.

PicoWorker support will not ask for an account password or one-time verification code. Signed-in users can use the support area, or contact hello@picoworker.xyz.

Source: https://picoworker.xyz/is-picoworker-legit

## Direct answers

### What is PicoWorker?

PicoWorker is an independent marketplace where earners complete eligible online tasks and businesses create campaigns and review results.

### Is PicoWorker free to join?

Yes. Creating an account and browsing available tasks are free.

### Does opening an offer earn a reward?

No. Opening an offer only begins the provider journey. The published requirements must be completed and tracked before verification.

### Why can a completion remain pending?

Pending means a completion was recorded but has not received its final verification result. Third-party providers may take longer than direct task review.

### Why do users see different tasks?

Availability can depend on country, device, audience rules, campaign capacity and previous participation. Confirm the eligibility on the task or provider page.

### Is PicoWorker the same as Picoworkers or SproutGigs?

No. PicoWorker at picoworker.xyz is a separate and independent service.

### Where are the complete answers?

See https://picoworker.xyz/faq and https://picoworker.xyz/how-picoworker-works.
